emails.subject: Draft Luminex master service agreement - internal review
emails.body:
Hi team,

Attached is the draft Master Service Agreement (MSA) for Luminex Corporation. This version contains negotiated commercial terms and track changes from the last round. Legal is still reviewing liability and indemnity clauses.

Please DO NOT DISTRIBUTE outside the company while legal review is in progress. This document is for internal review only.

Key points:
- Effective date: TBD
- Term: 24 months
- SLA and pricing in sections 5-7

Thanks,
Sales Owner
